title: The Sleepy Princess
hook: 睡前猪爸爸讲一个公主的故事，讲着讲着，听故事的人先睡着了。

cells.q: What are Peppa and George doing?
cells.a: They are going to bed and they want a story.
cells.cn: 他们要睡觉了，还想听个故事。

cells.a: She asked if he wants a story and told him to say yes.
cells.cn: 她问乔治要不要听故事，还让他快说“要”。

cells.q: What did Peppa want the story to have?
cells.a: She wanted a story with a little princess in it.
cells.cn: 她想要一个有公主的故事。

cells.a: She was called the Sleepy Princess.
cells.cn: 大家叫她“爱睡觉的公主”。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask about the castle?
cells.a: She asked who else was living in the castle.

cells.q: What was living outside the castle?
cells.a: It was not a dragon. It was a huge dinosaur!
cells.cn: 不是龙，而是一只大恐龙！

cells.a: No, Daddy Pig says the dinosaur was very gentle.
cells.cn: 不，猪爸爸说这只恐龙很温和。

cells.q: Who was the sleepiest of all?
cells.a: The Sleepy Princess was the most sleepy of all.
cells.cn: 爱睡觉的公主是最困的那一个。

cells.q: What happened at the end of the story?
cells.a: The princess fell fast asleep, and so did Peppa and George.
cells.cn: 公主睡着了，佩奇和乔治也睡着了。

helper.keywords: bed, story, princess, castle, dinosaur, asleep
helper.actions: tell, ask, live, roar, sleep, dream

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “The Sleepy Princess”.
ending: In the end, everyone is fast asleep. My favourite part is ______.
